Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. Our CIO (Anita Shah) and VP of Engineering (Martin Lee) are only available after business hours next week due to travel — is there any chance Redwood can run an evening briefing (6:30–7:15pm ET) and have either a VP/CTO from Redwood join for the first 10–15 minutes?
